Tap Add entry to record income or spending. Tap an entry to edit it. Swipe left or use its delete button to remove it; Undo appears briefly. Search filters titles and notes in the selected currency. Use Show more to load older matches.

Entries stay in the Android app sandbox. The Room database is not separately SQLCipher-encrypted; the PIN protects app access. Automatic backup and device transfer are disabled. Uninstalling or clearing storage deletes local data. No entries or PINs are uploaded. Public rates contact NBU; purchases contact Google Play; support opens Telegram only on your action. There are no ads or analytics SDKs.

Your PIN is stored only as a salted, slow verifier encrypted with an Android Keystore key. Repeated wrong PINs trigger increasing delays. Strong biometrics use a separate per-use key invalidated when enrollment changes. Use your PIN, then disable and re-enable biometrics after an enrollment change. Support cannot recover a forgotten PIN or lost device keys.

TG Plus on Google Play is a non-consumable lifetime purchase, not an auto-renewing subscription. Pending payments never unlock access. Restore with the same Google Play account. Signed Play purchases require periodic ownership verification and allow up to 7 days offline. Developer codes may be lifetime or time-limited. A local trial is available once for 7 OR 14 days, without payment details or charges.

Bank push notifications are parsed on this phone. Enable notification access once. Unambiguous payments are saved automatically; uncertain messages wait for review. SMS is optional, not required for push.
Play build: notification import only. SMS reception is included in the sideload variant; installer/device restrictions may apply.

Bank parsing happens on this device. Raw message texts, OTPs and full card numbers are not saved or sent to servers. Room stores extracted operations and review records in private app storage; system backup is disabled. Only the final four card digits are retained. Turning import off stops new ingestion; revoke notification/SMS access in Android settings to remove system access. CSV export is explicit and saves to the location you choose, which may be a cloud provider. PIN is an app lock, not database encryption. Optional exchange-rate, Play and system speech services are separate and may use the network. Imported statements are not bank-verified and must be reviewed.
Time is receipt or manual input time; no exact operation timestamp was provided.

Transfer: ignore transfers between your own accounts. Confirm only external spending or income.
This view shows up to 100 recent operations. Totals include every matching entry; the main ledger has search and paging.
Pending reviews and duplicate fingerprints will be deleted. Saved transactions are kept. Old notifications could be recognized again after clearing.
Use the exact package of your installed bank app. Do not assign messenger or unrelated apps. The last seen package is shown for diagnosis; unknown notification texts are not read.

1) Open api.monobank.ua and sign in with the monobank app. 2) Copy your personal token. 3) Paste it here. The app only reads your statement (read-only) and checks for new payments every ~15 minutes, even when closed. The token is stored encrypted on this phone.

monobank allows one request per minute. Wait a minute and try again.

The app reads SMS from banks (PRIVATBANK, monobank, SENSE, Oschad, PUMB…) as they arrive and imports payments automatically. Other SMS are ignored and never stored.

If Android blocks SMS access: Settings → Apps → TG Ledger → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then allow SMS again.
The cat assistant is part of Premium. Tap to unlock (14-day trial is free).

Enable access to notifications, turn on auto-import and allow background activity. New bank push is read without an open screen. Reconnect also reads bank notifications still visible in the shade, including recent ones. Android does not expose dismissed notification history to this app. After Force stop, open TG Ledger again. Some phones require Allow restricted settings before notification access.

For Privat24 Business AutoClient accounts, not ordinary retail Privat24 cards. In Privat24 Business → Integration (AutoClient) → API, create a token restricted to balances and transactions. Only statements are requested. The token is encrypted on this phone. First sync imports 30 days; later syncs run approximately every 15 minutes.
Could not read the statement. Check internet, AutoClient token and its read permissions. This token must belong to Privat24 Business.

Other banks: there is no universal API key. Open Banking needs a bank-supported consent flow and an authorised provider. For retail Privat24 and other banks, use push. Add the bank app package under App mapping → Other bank if it is missing. Never enter your bank password, PIN or CVV here.

Banks shows card, cash and bank spending. Free access: today. TG Plus or an active trial: 7 days, 30 days and all time. A period changes statistics, not whether operations are captured.

Recommended: Bank push → grant notification access → keep auto-import enabled. Recognition runs locally, without SMS or an API token, and writes clear payments into the ledger while its screen is closed. It supports plain, expanded, inbox and messaging notifications. OTPs, declines and balance-only messages are not operations. Ambiguous messages, transfers and possible duplicates need review.

Reconnect / opening the app reads bank notifications still in the notification shade. Dismissed messages cannot be recovered through notification access. Force-stop disables background work until you open the app again. Battery restrictions can delay or stop it.

API: monobank personal token and Privat24 Business AutoClient token are supported. PrivatBank AutoClient is for business/sole proprietor accounts, not ordinary retail cards. API sync is periodic, not instant. Other banks need a bank-specific authorised Open Banking integration; use push where available. A missing bank app can be mapped under Other bank.

Optional confirmations need Android notification permission. They do not affect saving. Import is not a certified bank statement: reconcile against your bank and check the review queue.

• monobank API kept; PrivatBank Business API added.
• Bank push import in the background and catch-up from the shade.
• One compact balance card and responsive labels/buttons.
• Protected Plus periods: 7 days, 30 days and all time.
• Expanded bank help and native Android 8/16 tests.
